_about: F32: the console-visit note — the first few times (content/tuning/lessons.json consoleNoteVisits) the player goes to the console mid-shift outside a lesson, this one line shows (src/game/lessons/firstBreakdowns.ts) until they close it, they're back in the tank, or for a short while (on a phone it can sit over the periscope, so it can always be closed): lesson time runs at the console's speed (25%), so 1.5 s here = 6 s. Words: content/text/en.json → lessons.console-note.
